title: Serving engine profile
description: One inference engine the operator can be integrated into. The engine is a separate axis from the GPU target and the workload: an integration or application qualification is a fact about (artifact, engine, target, workload). Registering more than one engine keeps the adapter, the gate ladder, and the consumer lock from silently assuming a single framework.

revision_is_pinned_by.description: Where the authoritative pin lives. The lab never owns an engine's revision pin; the consuming deployment does.

mechanism.description: How the operator reaches the engine. `pinned_patch` means a small patch whose file digest and required engine revision are bound into the release evidence.

stability.description: Whether the touched seams are an API the engine intends to keep. `unstable` obliges the consumer to carry a pinned patch and re-verify on every engine bump.

seams.description: The exact functions, registries, or CLI choice lists the integration touches. Naming them is what makes an engine upgrade reviewable instead of exploratory.

phase_scope.description: Which execution phases the operator is permitted to serve. Everything else must keep its stock backend and assert zero candidate calls.

gates.description: The integration gate ladder for this engine. Gate identity is per engine: an SGLang scheduler gate is not evidence about vLLM.

authority.description: What a pass licenses. Only `application` and `operational` gates bear on production acceptance. `fidelity` is its own class and licenses neither: a fidelity result is not a routing fact (`integration`), does not license production (`application`), and is more than a `diagnosis` -- it is the model-quality evidence an integration commit rests on, and it never becomes a performance or `quality-neutral` claim.

requires_target_authority.description: Which tier of hardware this gate must run on. A gate that must run on production hardware cannot be satisfied on the development tier.

known_issues.description: Engine defects that affect qualification. Recorded here because they change what a gate result means, not merely as trivia.
